Hremyach Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Chernihiv Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. Hremyach's earliest evidence of a Jewish community dates to the 19th century; 353 Jews (10.7 percent) lived there by 1897, and a house of prayer had already been established. The community survived a 1919 pogrom that killed 15 Jews, though the population had fallen to just 26 by 1939. This cemetery's boundaries have remained unchanged since 1939; the last known Hasidic burial took place in 1940, and in the five to seven years after the war, its stones were used for construction.
